title: rosa × suberecta var. shoolbredii
intro: Rosa × suberecta var. shoolbredii, commonly known as Rosa × centifolia 'Shoolbredii' or English rose, is a variety of rose plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression.
